characters.name: Nemo
characters.description: A brave little clownfish who gets separated from his dad and ends up in a fish tank in Sydney.

characters.name: Marlin
characters.description: Nemo's overprotective dad who crosses the entire ocean to find and rescue his son.

characters.name: Dory
characters.description: A cheerful blue tang fish who helps Marlin on his journey but forgets things very easily.

characters.name: Gill
characters.description: A wise moorish idol fish who lives in the dentist's tank and helps plan Nemo's escape.

translations.title: Finding Nemo (2003)
translations.description: A clownfish dad named Marlin travels across the Great Barrier Reef and beyond to rescue his son Nemo, who was taken to a dentist's fish tank in Sydney.
translations.history: The movie's colorful coral reef scenes were inspired by the real Great Barrier Reef in Australia, the largest coral reef system in the world!

translations.title: Tìm Nemo (2003)
translations.description: Một chú cá bố tên Marlin vượt qua rạn san hô lớn và cả đại dương để cứu con trai Nemo, đã bị đưa vào một bình cá trong phòng khám nha khoa ở Sydney.
translations.history: Các cảnh rạn san hô đầy màu sắc của phim được lấy cảm hứng từ Rạn San Hô Lớn thật sự ở Úc, hệ thống rạn san hô lớn nhất thế giới!
